transactionDesignClarification.beginFailure: Failed BEGIN request may leave server-side state uncertain due to network loss; client must not issue ROLLBACK, must destroy connection immediately via client.release(true)
transactionDesignClarification.preCommitFailure: Known operational query failure attempts explicit ROLLBACK; if rollback fails, connection destroyed
transactionDesignClarification.commitUncertainty: COMMIT failure leaves outcome uncertain; no ROLLBACK allowed; connection destroyed; manual reconciliation required
transactionDesignClarification.successfulCommit: Confirmed COMMIT releases healthy connection normally to pool
